score_years.description: seasons behind the typical good days
score_years.title: Score Years

CellDetailResponse.description:
Shared shape for `GET /spot` and `GET /cells/{id}`: today plus a
7-day outlook, per species, with the full factor breakdown.

habitats.description: the cell's forest types, largest share first; the shares sum to 1
habitats.title: Habitats

CellDetailResponse.title: CellDetailResponse

values.description: each factor's 0-1 value, in `factors` order, rounded to 3 decimals: 1 is favourable, 0 holds the score back. From the rule file that wins the cell that day (the one the breakdown explains); null where that rule file lacks the factor
values.title: Values

habitat.description: the cell's dominant forest type, a habitat of `config/habitats.yaml`
habitat.title: Habitat

FactorBreakdown.description:
One rule's contribution to a score, in evaluation order (gates, then
drivers, then stoppers) -- the "why this score" breakdown never re-sorts
by magnitude, so the same species always reads in the same order.

`contribution` is this factor's own multiplicative share of the day's
score: the product of every factor's `contribution` equals `score`.

`input`, `unit` and `days_ago` are the measurement this factor read; they
are null for a factor that measures nothing (season, habitat) and for days
scored without the measurement columns. `rule` says what the rule wanted.

days_ago.description: rain events: when the rain it scored ended
days_ago.title: Days Ago

growth_days.description: rain events on a growth clock: the growth since the rain ended, in days at the species' reference pace (warmth speeds it up, cold or dry air slows it down)
growth_days.title: Growth Days

input.description: what the factor measured: mm of rain, a temperature, a count of days, metres
input.title: Input

FactorBreakdown.title: FactorBreakdown

FactorChip.description:
One indicator analysis mode can put on the map: an enabled factor of the species' rules,
named like its row in the "why this score" breakdown.

id.description: the factor id, as `key` in the breakdown
id.title: Id

FactorChip.title: FactorChip

FactorRule.description:
What a rule asked of the measurement (`config/species/*.yaml`), so the copy can say what it
wanted. Which fields are set follows `kind`: a season window or habitat has none of them.

affinity.description: habitat: how well each forest type (`config/habitats.yaml`) suits the taxon, 0-1, for every type; the value is their mean weighted by the cell's `habitats`
affinity.title: Affinity

aggregate.description: how a window aggregate combines the days; `percent_of_normal` is their sum as a percentage of the cell's normal for the same days
aggregate.title: Aggregate

lag_days.description: rain events: the same shape over the lag the rain may have, in `lag_unit`
lag_days.title: Lag Days

lag_unit.description: rain events: `days` when `lag_days` counts calendar days (`days_ago`), `growth_days` when it counts the species' growth since the rain (`growth_days`)
lag_unit.title: Lag Unit

offset_days.description: the window ends this many days before the scored day
offset_days.title: Offset Days

op.description: what counts as a matching day, against `threshold`
op.title: Op

trapezoid.description: [zero_below, full_from, full_to, zero_above] over the measurement (`input`, in `unit`); a null pair leaves that side open
trapezoid.title: Trapezoid

variable.description: the weather variable or cell attribute the factor reads
variable.title: Variable

variable_unit.description: the unit of `variable` (and of `threshold`); '' when unitless
variable_unit.title: Variable Unit

where.description: gates and stoppers that apply only in part of the region

window_days.description: days of rain a rain event adds up, the days an aggregate or count spans, or how far back days_since looks
window_days.title: Window Days

FactorRule.title: FactorRule

FactorWhere.description:
Where a gate or stopper applies: its effect fades out as the cell's `variable` leaves the
trapezoid (full effect on the plateau, none outside).

variable.description: the cell attribute the condition reads
variable.title: Variable

FactorWhere.title: FactorWhere

FactorsResponse.description:
Analysis mode: every factor behind a species' conditions score, per woodland cell, for one
day. Only the days the daily job keeps the breakdown for (today -6 to +7) are stored.

factors.description: the union of the enabled factors over the species' rule files, in breakdown order (gates, drivers, stoppers)
factors.title: Factors

FactorsResponse.title: FactorsResponse

ForestTypesResponse.description:
Analysis mode's Bosco layer: every woodland cell's dominant forest type. Static grid data --
doesn't vary by species or day, so unlike `/scores` and `/factors` there's no date here.
ForestTypesResponse.title: ForestTypesResponse

fraction.description: its share of the cell's wooded area
fraction.title: Fraction

habitat.description: the forest type, a habitat of `config/habitats.yaml`
habitat.title: Habitat

good_days.description: a typical woodland cell's good days

OutlookPeriod.description: A week (EC46) or month (SEAS5) after the 7-day forecast. An outlook, not a forecast.

lead_rain_pct.description: rain over the lead window, as a percentage of normal

past_years.description: past seasons with scores for these days

issued.description: when the long-range forecast was fetched
issued.title: Issued

PlausibleSpeciesResponse.description:
Which species an area's woodland plausibly holds, from habitat and altitude alone (weather
and season aside), and how each species and taxon fared in every stored season.

plausible_fit.description: the habitat x altitude fit a cell needs for a taxon to count

RainTiltBands.description:
Lead-window rain at or above ``wetter_pct`` of normal tilts a period better; at or below
``drier_pct``, worse (``config/history.yaml``).
